Tap ON COURT or BENCH to sort players by total time, time on, name or number.

Fixed: the Add player sheet vanishing as it opened.

Drag a sheet down to close it.

Share a team with another coach. Send a team file from the team screen, or a single game from its summary, and import it from the Teams tab. Free.
On Android, the back button now asks before you leave a live game.

The first release of Sideline Hero. Set up your team, plan fair rotations before tip-off, and let the app guide every substitution during the game. Live scoring, seasons, and game summaries you can share or export are all there if you want them.
